report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200; only one of four was slow (344ms) while others were 62-78ms. Metrics show zero 502s and no dependency operation series. Traces show healthy sub-100ms spans but none correlate to the 344ms request. Insufficient evidence to attribute a root cause; need the slow request's trace and dependency latency data.
missing_evidence: Traces/logs for the slow 344ms checkout request to identify which downstream span (order, inventory, payment, postgres, redis) consumed the latency
Dependency operation metrics (simulator_dependency_operations_total) returned empty; need per-dependency latency/outcome series
Baseline latency distribution for /v1/checkout to determine whether 344ms is anomalous vs normal variance
Error/exception logs or non-200 responses correlated with the slow request
